summary:
FAIL (round 1). Core P1 surfaces largely exist and many audit gaps closed (move RH-12, archive WI-20, templates WI-5, rebalance WI-12, comment attachments AT-1/4/8/10-13, grouping/calendar/gantt views, canonical search).
Blocking: (P1-1, high) inherited project reach applies WORKSPACE-role authority on child projects, bypassing a restrictive parent override; (P1-2, high) PR-2..PR-4 roster absent, so assignment/manager/default-assignee only work for the project creator; (P1-3, high) three vacuous security tests.
Also fix in round 2: new check:tokens failures, project purge vs parent FK, open-children warning on all close paths, SLA/blocked badges on filtered lists, issue-link regression, page-wide attachment drop, intake default-assignee events, ancestor-load performance.
Checked, no issue: move route locks/FK ordering/alias/tenant/cross-org/eligibility; reach CTE tenant and soft-delete bounds and customer early-return; notification recipients re-checked for reach; default-assignee eligibility at set and apply; AT-4 internal-comment files; PR-13 legacy keys; permission matrix churn purely additive; no weakened assertions.
Requirements: 130 met, 37 partial, 9 not_met, 5 blocked (code-level; no browser evidence).

findings.problem: Inherited reach is granted from ancestor-project membership (evaluator.ts:391-396 and the new recursive CTE), but authority on the child is computed by can()/authorityFor against the child's own project id only. grantAppliesTo matches a project grant only when scopeId === target.projectId, so the parent's project-role grant never applies on the child and authority falls back to the WORKSPACE role. A person narrowed on the parent by a project-scope override (e.g. workspace 'member' + project 'viewer' on the parent) now reaches every descendant and acts there with full workspace-member authority (create, update, transition, request delete). Before P1 (ancestorProjectIds was [] everywhere and no project.parent_id existed) that person could not reach the children at all. Project-scope grants with arbitrary roles are writable today through SCIM group mappings (identity/repository.ts:3396) and JIT defaults, and re-parenting (project/policy.ts:92, elevated:false) silently extends this to a whole subtree. Contract: data-model.md:32 (membership carries one role_id and inherited_from) and PR-3 ('a different role on the child, which overrides') both imply the parent role is inherited by default.
findings.impact: Privilege escalation inside a workspace: a restrictive per-project role on a parent is bypassed on all of its descendants. Also the reverse (parent lead gets only workspace-member authority on children), which is fail-closed but wrong.
findings.recommended_fix: When the caller has no direct project grant on the target, select the nearest ancestor's project grants as the override in authorityFor (pass ancestorProjectIds into the authority target, or materialise inherited memberships with inherited_from per data-model.md). Add HTTP-level integration tests for a parent-only narrowed member (viewer on parent cannot update a child item) and a parent-only lead.

findings.requirement: PR-2, PR-3, PR-4 (and AS-1/AS-5, PR-6, PR-7, AS-11 in practice)
findings.problem: No project roster API or UI exists: no GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/projects/{id}/members, the 'inherited membership cannot be removed on the child' 409 exists only as the pure decideMemberRemoval used by a unit test, inherited_from is never written, and the re-parent 'preview who gains and loses access' edge case is not built. Assignee eligibility requires an explicit project roster row, and the only writers of project-scope grants are the creator grant, seed and IdP/SCIM mapping.
findings.impact: On a newly created project only its creator can be assigned, set as manager or set as default assignee; inherited members can never be assigned. Core P1 project management is unusable for teams without IdP mapping. Known-not-done, but these are core P1 requirements.
findings.recommended_fix: Build the roster routes (with inherited rows shown read-only, role override on child, 409 inherited_membership on removal) and the Kaneo members settings screen, plus the re-parent access preview; or obtain Thomas's explicit decision to defer PR-2..PR-4 to P2 and record it in the requirements index.

findings.problem: Three security negative tests cannot fail: (a) the search reach test creates a hidden project with NO work item (and even asserts hiddenItem is undefined), so a search that ignored reach still passes; (b) 'customer-side callers never inherit' wraps every assertion in if (identity) and the setup (person.side flipped without organisation membership) almost certainly resolves null, so nothing is asserted; (c) the cross-workspace template test uses a fabricated id rather than a real template from another workspace. No test asserts what a parent-only member may DO in a child project (finding P1-1 went undetected).
findings.impact: SV-3 reach scoping, customer non-inheritance and template tenant isolation have no effective regression protection despite the green suite.
findings.recommended_fix: Seed an item in the unreachable project (and a second workspace and a customer principal) and assert it is absent; assert identity is non-null or test via the HTTP route as a real customer; create a real template in another workspace; add inherited-authority tests for P1-1.

findings.problem: pnpm check:tokens exits 1 (322 messages vs 316 at a HEAD snapshot). P1 adds new failures: gantt contract pairs 123-126 no longer match, entries 33/34/187/188 drift, and new foreground/surface pairs (destructive-foreground on bg-card/60 and /70, foreground on bg-accent, foreground on bg-muted over bg-muted/40, secondary-foreground on bg-background) are unregistered and contrast-unchecked. The coordinator's evidence list omitted this gate.
findings.impact: AGENTS.md: a new gate failure is fixed, never exempted. Unverified contrast on new surfaces.
findings.recommended_fix: Update pairs.json for the changed gantt markup and register/contrast-check the new pairs until the P1 delta is zero.

findings.problem: Migration 0134 adds a RESTRICT (workspace_id,parent_id) FK, but PROJECT_ELIGIBLE does not exclude projects that still have child projects. A soft-deleted parent with any child (live, archived or not-yet-purged) is selected every night, its DELETE fails the FK, and the per-id catch swallows it, so it is never purged (exactly what the file's own comment says it avoids). Project delete (unlike archive, which uses hasActiveChildren) does not refuse a parent with live children.
findings.impact: 30-day purge guarantee silently broken for hierarchy parents; nightly failing work; children left pointing at a deleted parent.
findings.recommended_fix: Refuse delete of a project with live children (or detach/cascade explicitly with user confirmation), and add NOT EXISTS (child project) to PROJECT_ELIGIBLE with leaf-first ordering; add an integration test.

findings.problem: The open-children warning is wired only into the detail state control. The context-menu state change, board drag between columns and bulk transition close a parent with no warning.
findings.impact: Core P1 rule satisfied on one of four close paths.
findings.recommended_fix: Route every client transition path through useOpenChildrenGuard (or return the open-children list from the transition API and confirm generically).

findings.problem: SLA badge, row facts (blockedByOpenCount) and assignee display facts are attached only by GET list. As soon as a filter is applied the web switches to POST /api/work-items/search, which does not call loadWorkItemRowFacts/loadWorkItemRowSla.
findings.impact: SLA and blocked badges disappear on every filtered list/board/table.
findings.recommended_fix: Decorate search rows with the same loaders (shared helper) and add a test on the filtered route.

findings.problem: loadProjectAncestorIds loads EVERY project row of the workspace (loadWorkspaceAncestry) on each call, and one request can call it from several layers (workspace middleware, strict policy enforcement, work-item reach, attachment/comment access). Only callerReach memoises, and only its own calls. It also runs even when direct membership or sees_all already decides reach.
findings.impact: O(projects) scans multiplied per request on every project-scoped route; grows with workspace size.
findings.recommended_fix: Use a 4-hop recursive CTE for a single project's chain (as the SQL predicate already does), memoise on the request context, and short-circuit when direct membership / sees_all already grants reach.

findings.problem: The shared CommentEditor (comments, descriptions, version history) now registers WorkItemIssueLink instead of Kaneo's TaskDeskIssueLink. Its node view resolves only node.attrs.issueKey; stored nodes that carry only taskId/url (legacy Kaneo links) get a disabled query, render '…' forever and are not a link, whereas the original rendered a clickable link to the stored url.
findings.impact: Existing documents in the live database regress: old issue links become dead '…' chips.
findings.recommended_fix: Fall back to the original TaskDeskIssueLink view (or a plain link to attrs.url) when issueKey is empty; add a test with a taskId-only node.

findings.problem: Drop/paste intake listens on the whole document. WorkItemDetail is also mounted in the side pane over board/list/calendar/gantt, so with a pane open a file dropped anywhere on the board, or pasted into any plain input, is attached to the open item.
findings.impact: Files attached to the wrong work item without explicit intent.
findings.recommended_fix: Scope listeners to the detail container (or require focus within it), matching Kaneo's drop-zone behaviour.

findings.problem: Intake conversion now applies the project default assignee (AS-11 fallback), but like the pre-existing request-type path it writes no work_item.assigned event/activity, sends no assignee notification and adds no implicit watcher.
findings.impact: Default-assigned intake items are silent to the assignee.
findings.recommended_fix: Emit the same assignment event/notification and implicit watcher as the create path.

findings.problem: 0-byte untracked file with a typo'd name (mtime 2026-10-23 11:24, same as workspace-owner-admin-reach.test.ts; likely a stray redirect). It matches the integration glob; Vitest reports 'No test suite found' for an empty file.

findings.problem: Only sla.*, cf.* and label are treated as known-but-unavailable (422). requester, cycle, module and epic fall to 'Unknown filter field' 400; the organisation filter is not implemented.
findings.impact: Contract says a recognised field not yet backed returns 422 naming it.
findings.recommended_fix: Add requester/cycle/module/epic to the unavailable set (422) and implement or 422 organisation; test each.

findings.problem: Layout restore reads localStorage only (readProjectLayoutPreference); the server layout.<projectId> preference is written but never read.
findings.impact: Per-user preference does not follow the user across devices/browsers.
findings.recommended_fix: Read the server preference (fall back to local) when no ?layout= is present.

findings.problem: Single-item deletion approval shows only key, title and children count; the project name (present in the summary) is not rendered and there is no requester/portal-visibility impact or 30-day recovery text.
findings.impact: WI-23 dialog content contract unmet.
findings.recommended_fix: Render project, requester/portal impact and the recovery period in the single-item approval.

findings.problem: Templates/Checklists switch is two Buttons swapping variant: a text-button workaround for tabs, no aria-selected, no arrow keys.
findings.impact: AGENTS.md forbids text-button workarounds; inconsistent with Kaneo settings.
findings.recommended_fix: Use packages/ui Tabs (or ToggleGroup) as Kaneo settings pages do.

findings.problem: Project General settings now mixes three save models (Kaneo autosave, key confirm dialog, immediate-save Parent, explicit Save for manager/dates/default assignee) side by side; field labels are native <label> rather than the Form/FormLabel used on the same page.
findings.impact: Breaks the Kaneo settings interaction model; confusing.
findings.recommended_fix: Follow Kaneo's autosave pattern (or one explicit Save) for the whole planning block and use FormLabel/Label.

findings.problem: New DndContexts pass no accessibility announcements/screenReaderInstructions; Kaneo's board does (kanban-board/index.tsx:399).
findings.impact: Screen readers hear dnd-kit English defaults in every locale; parity regression.
findings.recommended_fix: Reuse the Kaneo localized board announcements.

findings.problem: New states editor reorders with native HTML5 draggable/onDragStart, no keyboard or touch path (copies Kaneo column-editor.tsx:214, but it is a new P1 control) and it stacks above Kaneo's column editor which reorders the same states.
findings.impact: Inaccessible reorder and two competing orderings on one page.
findings.recommended_fix: Use dnd-kit sortable like the board/list and merge or clearly separate the two editors.

findings.problem: Composer is neutral in both modes citing an 'owner decision', but CA-5 still requires a distinct internal background and no decision/contract change is recorded.
findings.impact: Requirement and implementation disagree.
findings.recommended_fix: Record Thomas's decision and amend CA-5, or add a distinct internal treatment using tokens.

findings.problem: type=all still runs the legacy task/comment/activity searches although the route description says tasks are only under type=tasks; the palette discards those after the server already capped the page.
findings.impact: Legacy hits can push canonical work items off the result page; extra query cost against SV-5.
findings.recommended_fix: Exclude legacy kinds from type=all.

findings.problem: A staff file attached to a public comment defaults to customer_visible=true (comment.visibility === 'public' && (requestedVisibility ?? true)); AT-3 says staff uploads default to not visible. No route changes visibility afterwards. Internal-comment files are correctly forced false and comment visibility is immutable (update-comment.ts:34), so AT-4 holds.
findings.impact: Customer exposure by default once portal surfaces comment files.
findings.recommended_fix: Default to false unless the client explicitly opts in (composer can show the toggle), or record the decision against AT-3.

findings.problem: Children keep parent_id to a soft-deleted parent, and work-item purge requires no child row, so a deleted parent with live children is never purged. No restore route or reveal filter exists for deleted items.
findings.impact: 30-day purge/recovery window not honoured for hierarchy parents.
findings.recommended_fix: Detach children at delete approval (as RH-11 describes) or exclude live children from the purge check; carry restore UI to P2.

findings.problem: People search is workspace-scoped, not reach-scoped: a project-limited agent can list every active staff member's name and job title.
findings.impact: Minor directory disclosure inside the tenant.
findings.recommended_fix: Confirm intended; otherwise limit to people sharing a reachable project.

findings.problem: Notification/inbox reach calls reaches() without ancestorProjectIds, so an inherited-only member is dropped from notifications though they can read the item. Fail-closed but inconsistent with callerReach.
findings.impact: Missing notifications for inherited members.
findings.recommended_fix: Pass ancestors (after P1-1 is fixed).

findings.problem: All 173 new keys are verbatim English in every non-English locale (check:i18n only checks presence); SLA badge hard-codes m/h/d suffixes instead of Intl.
findings.impact: Non-English users see English on all P1 surfaces.
findings.recommended_fix: Translate or leave keys absent for fallback tooling; format durations via Intl.

findings.problem: Transition route OpenAPI description still says set_assignee 'default' resolves to no assignee; setting a project default state does not check every type's workflow can leave it; request-type lookup in resolveProjectDefaultAssignee is not workspace-scoped (latent, no caller passes it).

findings.recommended_fix: Fix description, validate outbound transition on set-default, scope request-type lookup by workspace.

findings.impact: Audit trail inflated with non-downloads.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a thumbnail/preview variant that does not audit as a download (or dedupe).
